entities.summary: Irdabama, was an Ancient Persian businesswoman during the reign of Darius the Great. She is the most well known and wealthiest businesswoman attested to in the records of the Achaemenid Empire at Persepolis. According to Lloyd Llewellyn-Jones (2013), recently uncovered texts in Persepolis indicate that Darius' mother was Irdabama.
